s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Roast 250g cherry tomatoes with oil and salt for 15 minutes. Whip 250g ricotta with lemon zest and pepper, spread on the toasts and top with tomatoes, basil and a little honey.

Make a firm risotto with 300g arborio rice and 1L stock, stir through 100g peas, 100g diced ham and 50g parmesan, then cool. Roll into 16 balls, crumb in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with 400g warm marinara.

m.note: Ben's family dinner on Staten Island
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with breadcrumbs and an egg, roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and torn basil and simmer 40 minutes. Toss through 500g cooked rigatoni with plenty of parmesan.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons with 4 eggs, 150g sugar and 150ml cream. Pour into the case and bake at 150C for 20 minutes until just set. Chill and serve with whipped cream.

d.note: Ben taking Andie to the basketball
d.how: Chill the lager well and pour into plastic cups like at the game. For anyone not drinking, pour lemonade over ice. Cheer loudly and ask a lot of questions during the important bits.
